text:
marie_p: quick heads-up — partner asks for a CZ on driver pins after the weekend regression. acme reported perf/quant regressions on A100 with driver 535.x + CUDA 12.3 :eyes:

marie_p: can we align on a short-term policy (marketplace images + dedicated) so they can ship w/o rolling back infra?

jess_acme: thanks — yes, our SI hit noisy quant errors in production after their kernel update. we need a recommended pin and an ETA for a hotfix. currently blocked on cert for marketplace image.

david_p: copying in infra notes — we saw the same signal in our nightly A100 perf tests. root cause looks like a fused-kernel codepath change in CUDA 12.3 that regresses certain int8/quant kernels when driver >=535.2

rachel_eng: immediate suggestion: pin driver to 534.x + CUDA 12.2 for marketplace images and dedicated pools until we ship a patched kernel. long term: switch to runtime fallback for affected kernels.

sam_sre: we can schedule a canary lane for affected customers tomorrow 03:00 UTC. recommend these steps for the short-term plan:
- marketplace images: pin driver 534.86, cuda 12.2
- dedicated: allow opt-in to 534 pin via tenant config
- fallback: route to quant-safe model variant when telemetry detects failures

opsbot: CI alert — nightly-inference-a100: regression detected 2026-03-20T07:45Z
```
FAILED: perf/quant/roundtrip_check (delta +18%)
Trace: kernel fuser path mismatch
```

marie_p: can someone paste the exact package pins we should circulate to partners (also include quick rollback steps)?

david_p: putting example snippet — share with partners and marketplace ops:```
# recommended short-term pins for affected images
DRIVER_VERSION=534.86
CUDA_VERSION=12.2.1
# docker base image
FROM nvidia/cuda:${CUDA_VERSION}-runtime-ubuntu22.04
# kernel/userland compatibility note: use driver ${DRIVER_VERSION} on hosts
```
Rollback steps: boot hosts to previous driver, redeploy marketplace image with new tag `redwood/inference:cuda12.2-pin-20260320`

jess_acme: that works. what's the ETA for an internal patch? we need a date to tell integrators.

rachel_eng: engineering estimate: we have a PR for the fused-kernel guard in review — if CI passes, we can cut a hotfix build and vendor patch by EOD +1 (2026-03-21). ops can sign & push marketplace images within 24h after that.

sam_sre: scheduling note: I'll run a 10% canary once hotfix is deployed, monitor token-level error spike and p50/p95 latency. will abort on >3% error or CPU spike >20%.

marie_p: I'll draft partner comms: include the pin snippet, canary dates, rollback steps, and a short FAQ re: why pinning is needed. tagging @jess_acme so SI teams can prep. :thumbsup:

jess_acme: appreciate it. can you also confirm whether signed driver binaries will be available for our air-gapped installs?

rachel_eng: yes — we will provide signed artifacts and a checksum manifest. we'll also publish a step-by-step for offline hosts (installer tar + driver .run + verification SHA256).

david_p: follow-up action items:
- @rachel_eng: publish signed driver artifacts + manifest (by 2026-03-21 18:00 UTC)
- @sam_sre: canary plan + alert thresholds (by 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC)
- @marie_p: partner comms draft + marketplace ops note (by 2026-03-20 23:00 UTC)
- @jess_acme: confirm SI rollout window and any compliance gating (ASAP)

opsbot: scheduled canary job created: canary/a100-quant-pin-20260321 (runs 2026-03-21T03:00Z)

marie_p: thanks all. small ask — include the observed telemetry snippet when you send comms so integrators can triage quickly.

jess_acme: will do. sending to our SI leads now.

rachel_eng: adding test checklist for partners: 1) smoke run with sample quant model, 2) validate token-level correctness, 3) run perf smoke (1000 tokens) and compare p50/p95 against baseline. i'll attach scripts after PR merges.

marie_p: perfect. closing this thread once comms live and canary green.

sam_sre: noted — i'll post results in this thread.

opsbot: deployment-note: marketplace-image `redwood/inference:cuda12.2-pin-20260320` pushed to staging registry 2026-03-20T21:34Z

jess_acme: thanks team :raised_hands:
